I abstained and wrote `verdict.txt`. I did not implement `transition_function` and did not run `check.py`.

**Reason:** No rule of (state, action) can replay all 20 transitions. Two transitions conflict:

| Transition | Before state | Action | After state |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | initial state | 2 | no change |
| 19 | the same initial state (I checked that they are equal) | 2 | `legend_cyan_0` x moves from 13 to 14 |

Hidden state cannot fix this. The before state of transition 19 does not match the after state of transition 18: the cursor is at x 15, not 22. Thus the continuity gate requires the stateless default, and that default must give the result of transition 0.
